high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "entertainmenttonight." The post features two individuals, a man and a woman, posing together against a backdrop with bold orange and black colors. The man has short, styled hair and is wearing a blue blazer over a light blue shirt. The woman has long, wavy brown hair and is dressed in a sleeveless outfit with a gold chain necklace. The text overlay on the image reads: "We would send images to each other of things we found to be hot and sexy." GLEN POWELL, InStyle Below the image, there is additional text
